title: The Peterkin papers
author: Lucretia P. (Lucretia Peabody) Hale
longDescription: Hale is a collection of humorous stories written during the late 19th century.

authorInfo.bio: Lucretia P. (Lucretia Peabody) Hale (1820–1900) wrote The Peterkin papers. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.

rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.

rightsReview.policy: US public-domain source; all listed creative contributors died by 1900. Unknown dates excluded. Edition screening, not legal certification.
